marketing_wrapper: Very heavy. 01 is pure marketing (a football render, 'DraftKings Sports | Football' lockup, '#1 SPORTSBOOK FOR LIVE BETTING'). Every frame uses a diagonal split between DraftKings green (#60b511) and black, with a condensed bold all-caps caption and an 'odds and screens shown for illustrative purposes only' disclaimer. No full app screen is shown. 03, 04 and 06 show UI components cut out and floated on the backdrop, many with a thick orange (#f47a20-ish) highlight outline. 02 overlays a white bet-slip card on a dimmed phone and a collage of player photos. 05 shows a phone with a white 'Order Successful' card overlaid. 06 adds 3D dice, chips, a slot '7' and coins. Real UI is about 0% in 01 and about 35-55% elsewhere, all restaged.

palette.accent_strategy: Green carries both brand and money. Odds prices are in green text (-110, +160), payouts and 'Trade Placed' are green, the wallet balance '$813.96 +' is green and the success check is lime. Orange appears as a social-proof flame ('25K People Place This Bet', '8.1K People Placed This Bet') and as the marketing highlight outline. Yellow outlines the 'Live SGP' badge; a green outline marks 'Parlay'. The bet slip and success sheet are white light-mode cards inside the dark app.
palette.source: palette.json 03 (#131312 26% UI surface, #60b511 backdrop), 04 (#121212, #8ec957 green odds text), 05 (#0e0e0e, #ffffff 25% success card, #98cc66), 06 (#101115). #000000 and #60b511 at scale are the diagonal-split backdrop. Orange visually matched, unmeasured.

direction_fit.why: The text record's unverified tag holds up. The super-app mixes a sportsbook odds grid, social-proof parlays ('25K People Place This Bet'), celebrity picks, prediction-market trades on crypto and politics, and a casino lobby with a crash game ('Rocket'). The in-app odds grid itself is a conventional dark sportsbook, so the arcade character comes from the promo, social-proof and casino layers and from the brand-green-as-money colouring.

notes: Scoreboard anatomy. Score numerals: no live score shown. Yellow live counters ('46', '85') beside Live SGP legs look like live stat progress. Team colour and logos: helmet renders as team icons (Dallas, San Francisco, LA, Houston); no team-colour fills. Live state: a yellow-outlined 'Live SGP' badge only. No Live Activity or widget is shown. Match-centre density: n/a (no game screen). Betting and odds typesetting: American odds throughout; each cell stacks the line in white ('+3.5', 'O 44.5') over the price in green ('-110'); moneyline cells show the price alone (+160 / -192); combined parlay odds are right-aligned bold (+450, -105); stake inputs are '$ 0.00' boxes; the predictions success card lists 'Trade Amount: $10.00' and 'Payout: $62.50', with the payout in green; casino rows show 'Min $1 • Max $4000'. Green colours every price, favourites included, so colour signals 'bettable' rather than good or bad. Social proof ('25K People Place This Bet' with a flame) sits directly above the bet button.
